subject: Runtime V2 Launch Coordination: gating questions & documentation owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cloudpartner.io>, Bethany Cruz <bethany@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime V2 launch — gating checklist and doc owners

Team —

We need to lock down the launch gating items and assign owners for all customer-facing and operational docs for the Runtime V2 rollout. Target window we're discussing is Aug 3–6 for the initial canary. Before we publish a firm date we need confirmations on the following items: 

1) Docs & enablement: release notes, migration guide (breaking changes), SDK upgrade notes, and a short FAQ for common errors. Owner suggested: Marissa (PRs to be open by Wed 7/21).

2) Support & runbook: on-call playbook, degradation/fallback behavior (quantization fallback), detection & alert triggers. Owner: Ops (Jonas) + support.

3) Security & compliance checks: any outstanding audit evidence, data residency notes for the feature, and explicit list of configurations that are not yet supported (e.g., HSM-backed keys on private clusters). Owner: Markus — can you confirm the list and whether it blocks GA?

4) Partner/marketplace readiness: partner listing copy, contract addendum (minimal), and sandbox credentials for Marketplace partners. Tom/Bethany — what do you need from us to finish partner-side validation?

I've attached a short launch-outline-v1.pdf with a proposed swimlane and timeline. Please reply with confirmations, objections, or edits by EOD Mon 7/19 so I can consolidate for the leadership sync on Tue.

If we can't get clear owners for (2) and (3) by Monday, we should push the canary by one week — don't want to expose customers to ambiguous rollback paths.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior PM, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cloudpartner.io>, Bethany Cruz <bethany@enterpriseco.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime V2 launch — gating checklist and doc owners

Hannah —

I can own the customer docs (release notes, migration guide, SDK notes, FAQ). I'll create the enablement-plan.xlsx and share a first draft Monday morning. My ask for owners:

- Migration guide (Marissa) — needs code snips from runtime team by Fri 7/23
- Release notes (Marissa) — need a short bulleted changes list + any known regressions
- Quick start example (Dev sample) — Marcus? or Platform SDK team

Question: do we want a short "what goes wrong" troubleshooting table inside the migration guide or a separate support-runbook-draft.md? My vote is split but we should avoid duplication. I'll link a canonical runbook if Jonas wants to keep the operational playbook separate.

Attaching enablement-plan.xlsx (stub) — will include owners, due dates, and a checklist for doc review.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime V2 launch — gating checklist and doc owners

Hannah / team —

Operational constraints to call out: 

- Canary strategy: we can do a staged canary (1% -> 10% -> 50% over 48 hours) but need explicit rollback criteria and an automatic fallback to the last stable model variant. Please confirm which metrics will trigger auto-rollback (latency p95 > Xms, error rate > Y%).
- Capacity: request one Dedicated slot for 2 days (will file INF-2104). Without the slot, we may face throttling under the canary traffic pattern.
- KV cache migration: Runtime V2 changes the KV layout for sharded caches; migration will be transparent but requires a short warm-up period and we should document potential elevated latency for first 2k requests per shard.

I'll draft the support-runbook-draft.md and link it from the enablement plan. My draft will include step-by-step rollback and debug checklist.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
SRE Manager, Runtime Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cloudpartner.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bethany Cruz <bethany@enterpriseco.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime V2 launch — gating checklist and doc owners

Hannah/Marissa —

Partner side: we need an API contract freeze date to run our compatibility tests against the sandbox. Can you confirm the API surface that is considered immutable for the canary? Also request: sandbox credentials and a short TL;DR of behavioral changes (e.g., tokenization differences, fallback behavior).

On the marketplace listing front, Bethany (EnterpriseCo) needs the partner-side copy and a signed addendum if any SLA changes are involved. If you can share the final release notes and a short partner integration checklist by Tue EOD, we'll OK the listing.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Reyes
Head of Integrations
CloudPartner.io

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cloudpartner.io>, Bethany Cruz <bethany@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime V2 launch — gating checklist and doc owners

Thanks everyone — quick summary and decisions so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions: 
- Launch window: proceed with the canary starting Aug 3, contingent on owners delivering the items below by EOD Mon 7/26.
- Docs: Marissa owns customer docs; Jonas will own support runbook. Marissa to include a concise troubleshooting table inside the migration guide and link to Jonas' runbook for on-call procedures.
- Security: Markus to confirm any blocking compliance artifacts by Fri 7/23; outstanding items are data residency wording for private deployments and the HSM note (non-blocking if documented).
- Ops: Jonas to file INF-2104 for the Dedicated slot; rollback criteria default will be latency p95 > 450ms or error rate > 2% sustained for 10 minutes unless leadership adjusts.
- Partners: Tom/Bethany will get sandbox creds and partner checklist by Tue EOD; API contract freeze is Tue 7/21 EOD.

Action items (owners & due dates): 
- Marissa: first drafts of release notes, migration guide, SDK notes (7/21). attach: enablement-plan.xlsx
- Jonas: support-runbook-draft.md and INF-2104 ticket (7/22).
- Markus: compliance checklist + HSM/data residency wording (7/23).
- Hannah: consolidate and send final go/no-go for leadership sync (7/27).

I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment on Tue 7/27 10:00–10:30 PT to confirm final go/no-go. If you have objections to owners/dates, flag now.

Attachments: launch-outline-v1.pdf, enablement-plan.xlsx, support-runbook-draft.md (in-flight)

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior PM, Runtime
Redwood Inference
